purpose: Evaluate checkpoint recovery, readable replacement, retained fault outcomes, repeated resource measurements, and cross-host reproducibility without broadening Wave Two claims.

measurement_plan.order: alternate readable/composed order; measure checkpoint mode after each pair
measurement_plan.claim_boundary: Measurements compare only the declared implementations in the recorded environment and never establish global language superiority.

partitions.development: checked-in deterministic workload and mutation fixtures
partitions.public_reproduction: hosted CI execution on declared runner images
partitions.protected_holdout: requires an independently controlled seed or corpus not present in the public repository

selection_policy.rationale: Wave Three characterizes composition overhead and recovery behavior; it does not select a candidate from performance noise.

unknown_policy: FAIL dominates UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN dominates PASS; required unavailable evidence yields REVIEW_REQUIRED and cannot produce formal PASS.
d4_policy: A successful binding regeneration and readable replacement drill may support only the regeneration/replacement subclaim. Full MNCDS-D4 remains UNKNOWN without release controls, monitoring, retirement, and independent witnessing.
